mapper.insert: INSERT INTO csv_jobs (job_type, admin_id, created_at, csv_file_path, status, modified_count, error_message, error_code) VALUES (#{job.jobType}, #{job.adminId}, NOW(), #{job.csvFilePath}, #{job.status}, #{job.modifiedCount}, #{job.errorMessage}, #{job.errorCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE csv_jobs SET status = #{status}, modified_count = #{modifiedCount}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{jobId}
